body:
### Summary

When data scripts with `#!python` shebangs are re-written using a `#!/bin/sh` re-director, if the next line in the data script is a [PEP-263](https://peps.python.org/pep-0263/) source code encoding line, the line is not preserved in the 2nd line position and, as a result, the source file encoding is not respected.

Below is a self contained repro. This was realized via work on https://github.com/pex-tool/pex/issues/3248 over in Pex; although I know of no package in the wild with such a data script. I was just covering my bases over in Pex and thought you might want to know about this issue over here.
 
The repro uses this Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.5-debian-slim

RUN mkdir /tmp/repro
WORKDIR /tmp/repro

SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]
RUN <<EOC
  set -euo pipefail

  mkdir project
  (
    cd project

    cat <<EOF > pyproject.toml
[build-system]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
requires = ["setuptools==84.0.0"]
EOF

    cat <<EOF > setup.cfg
[metadata]
name = custom_encoding_data_script
version = 0.1.0

[options]
scripts = script
EOF

    cat <<EOF > script
#!python
# coding=windows-1252
EOF
    echo -n 'print("' >> script
    echo -n $'\x80\x99' >> script
    echo '")' >> script

    uvx --from build pyproject-build -w -o ../wheels
  )

  VENV="$PWD/venv/$(printf '%s%s' {0..7}{0..7})"
  uv venv --python 3.14.7 "$VENV"
  uv pip install --python "$VENV" wheels/*.whl
  cat \
    <(head -1 "$VENV/bin/script") \
    <(echo "# coding=windows-1252") \
    <(tail +2 "$VENV/bin/script") > \
  "$VENV/bin/script-fixed"
  chmod +x "$VENV/bin/script-fixed"

  cat <<EOF > repro.sh
    echo "Using uv installed data script:"
    "$VENV/bin/script" || true
    echo
    echo "Using hackily corrected script:"
    "$VENV/bin/script-fixed"
EOF
  chmod +x repro.sh
EOC

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash"]
```

And then run the repro:
```console
:; docker run --rm -it repro-issues-3248
root@632ac7dfdfbb:/tmp/repro# ./repro.sh 
Using uv installed data script:
  File "/tmp/repro/venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/script", line 5
    print("��")
           ^
SyntaxError: Non-UTF-8 code starting with '\x80' in file /tmp/repro/venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/script on line 5, but no encoding declared; see https://peps.python.org/pep-0263/ for details

Using hackily corrected script:
€™
root@632ac7dfdfbb:/tmp/repro# 
exit
```

The issue is seen directly inspecting the installed script:
```console
# Bad - source coding line is shifted below '''...''' re-director block:
root@291028cd06d7:/tmp/repro# head venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/script
#!/bin/sh
'''exec' '/tmp/repro/venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/python3' "$0" "$@"
' '''
# coding=windows-1252
print("��")

# Fixed hackily for demo purposes:
root@291028cd06d7:/tmp/repro# head venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/script-fixed 
#!/bin/sh
# coding=windows-1252
'''exec' '/tmp/repro/venv/00010203040506071011121314151617202122232425262730313233343536374041424344454647505152535455565760616263646566677071727374757677/bin/python3' "$0" "$@"
' '''
# coding=windows-1252
print("��")
```

### Platform

Linux 7.0.0-30-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux (but presumably a general posix system issue)

### Version

uv 0.12.5

### Python version

Python 3.14.7 (but likely not relevant)
title: PEP-263 source encoding line is not preserved in the correct position (2nd line) for a data script when using the `#!/bin/sh` re-director trick.
